authority_note: This GPT-K record reflects Brew repository architecture-policy updates through 2026-09-19. The latest changes clarify bounded delegation and feature preservation; they do not by themselves prove new runtime behavior. Current source/runtime, exact local revision, live provider/tool behavior, CI, and installed-runtime evidence continue to outrank this record.

delegation_model.rule: Delegates may reason autonomously within assigned task scope, but must not become competing authorities for the top-level user goal, canonical policy, side effects, evidence truth, persistence truth, or product-level completion.
delegation_model.feature_preservation: Working and useful capabilities are kept; improvable capabilities are adapted/enhanced; useful overlap is combined; removal requires evidence of broken, fake, unreachable, unsafe, obsolete-after-migration, or conflicting-authority behavior.

verified_changes.change: Removed active request-semantic tool preselection from the runner foundation. The canonical reasoning loop now receives the full governed executable registry instead of a regex/token-scored subset. Deleted the obsolete task-tool-selection module, response-decision-layer, and stale runtime build script; removed stale workflow reference.

Added regression coverage that rejects semantic tool preselection, semantic router/planner re-entry into the canonical runner, and tool-selection telemetry being used as an execution capability boundary.

Aligned the dynamic prompt tool catalogue with the native tool loop by using describeForModel({ includeUnavailable: false }); the model now sees the governed executable tool set consistently in both context and native tool schemas.

Added canonical read-only git.status and git.diff_summary capabilities through Brew's governed capability registry and bounded adapters. Focused tests 2/2, readiness 10/10, full suite 421/421, runtime check and UI build reported PASS.
Clarified root AGENTS policy: bounded subagents, specialist agents, teams and workers may enhance Brew; added explicit feature-preservation disposition rules.
Updated ADR-0001 to distinguish one primary user-level reasoning authority from valid delegated agent/team reasoning; architecture cleanup must preserve working capability.
Updated Brew Agent Architecture with delegated-scope autonomy and KEEP/ADAPT/COMBINE/MIGRATE/REMOVE disposition guidance.
Updated Brew workspace plan with a delegation and feature-preservation contract covering roles/subagents and distributed workers.

canonical_runtime_findings.detail: brew/runtime/agents/agent-tool-loop.mjs sends the governed tool catalogue to the provider, accepts native model tool actions, executes through the registry, returns receipts/evidence to the same loop, and requires evidence-backed finalization after tool use.

prepareRunnerFoundationTurn no longer calls createTaskToolRegistryView or requestHints. It returns the governed executable registry and selectedTools is compatibility telemetry representing all exposed executable tools, not heuristic semantic selection.
Project registry filtering remains a deterministic permission/configuration boundary over allowed or disabled tools and does not interpret user request semantics.
Plugin registry composition exposes active plugin tools and delegates execution without taking semantic request ownership.

The legacy subagent compatibility runtime remains intentionally disabled and fail-closed in the currently proven path. This does not prohibit bounded subagents/teams as a product capability; future or existing working delegates are valid when they use canonical Brew policy/execution/evidence contracts and do not become competing user-level authorities.

The natural-language classifyScenario path was found only in tests. Canonical start.js uses classifyExplicitCommand for explicit slash/URL syntax and ordinary natural language falls through to the LLM reasoning loop.

brew/observability/operation-journal.mjs is committed on main, imported by canonical agent/runner/gateway paths, and covered by operation-journal tests. Older REMAINING_AUDIT_AREAS text claiming it is uncommitted is STALE. Process-loss/exactly-once acceptance remains pending.

Legacy compatibility modules remain fail-closed on the previously proven path. Their fail-closed status is not a blanket ban on subagents/teams: useful delegated-agent capability may be preserved or reintroduced through canonical Brew contracts when there is a proven feature requirement.

do_not_recreate: request-semantic regex or token tool selection before the model
a second planner/controller outside the canonical turn
deterministic completion authority replacing model evidence judgment
parallel tool registries when the canonical governed registry can be extended
unbounded multi-agent/subagent/team orchestration that creates competing user-goal, policy, execution, evidence, persistence, or completion authority
architecture cleanup that deletes a working useful capability solely because it uses agent/team/planner/supervisor/worker terminology
acceptance_falsifiers: Any ordinary natural-language request is semantically routed before the canonical reasoning model.
Any heuristic request classifier hides otherwise executable tools from the model.
selectedTools telemetry becomes an execution boundary or TOOL_NOT_SELECTED_FOR_TASK-style gate.
Dynamic prompt advertises tools that the native model tool schema marks unavailable.
A planner/controller or delegated agent acquires competing authority over the top-level user goal or bypasses canonical Brew policy/execution/evidence/completion contracts.
A completion claim after tool use cannot be linked to recorded receipt/evidence identity.

evidence_boundary.rule: Current main includes a 2026-09-19 documented architecture-policy clarification permitting bounded subagents/teams/workers while preserving one primary user-level Brew authority and canonical runtime boundaries. The prior source/test evidence remains valid for the previously tested runtime surfaces; these documentation commits do not themselves prove new delegated-agent runtime behavior or installed acceptance.
